adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed with `&&` between `isTeamAdmin(...)` and `isTeamOwner(...)`, meaning the user must be both a team admin and a team owner to pass the permission check. This contradicts the variable name and the apparent intent of allowing either role; as written, a non-owner team admin would fail `isTeamAdminOrOwner` and, if not the organizer/attendee, would be incorrectly rejected with `FORBIDDEN`.
